observations.observation: Provider COMPLETED was observed for units with no durable result commit; the recovery scanner correctly reclassified them rather than accepting completion.
Ingestion falsely rejected honest work seven times across four cohorts and three model families, always because the branch advanced after emission.
Four cohort branches merged with zero conflicts, then nine more, confirming disjoint per-owner subtrees prevent write collisions.
A snapshot-versus-live coupling defect appeared eight-plus times across four model families, including inside the document written to describe it.
One dispatch failed at the provider with zero work produced and was recovered from immutable input at a higher fence with no founder relay.

challenges.challenge: a2 falsified ten of its own twelve hypotheses against the coordinator's control plane and returned nine reproducible defects.
a10 attacked nine named invariants and broke or bounded six, including a path to completing one unit twice with different artifacts.
a9 undermined two load-bearing coordinator assumptions and showed an intact manifest hash gives no source-byte closure.
a1 showed a pure hash chain cannot detect tail truncation, and that the coordinator's own test encoded that blindness as acceptable.
a5 found a fence-token collision by deterministic simulation that sequential injection missed entirely.
a8 ran a6's read-back audit inward and found all six of its own result records fail their declared locator.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Durable-execution invariants (idempotency key, fence, checkpoint, outbox) predict which fault classes are survivable.
external_hypotheses.outcome: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — checkpoint is a precondition beneath idempotency-key dedup, not an independent lever.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Content-addressed custody beats message-passing return under callback loss.
external_hypotheses.outcome: SUPPORTED — 100% recovery at 0 to 100% drop, against message-passing tracking 1 minus drop probability exactly.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Preregistered acceptance criteria reduce escaped defects.
external_hypotheses.outcome: SUPPORTED — 5 of 5 defects caught preregistered against 0 of 5 post-hoc.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic simulation testing reaches interleavings sequential injection cannot.
external_hypotheses.outcome: SUPPORTED — 84 of 90 exhaustive violations found against 0 of 24 sequential.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: An append-only log with projections beats mutable status files for this programme.
external_hypotheses.outcome: SUPPORTED — 148 of 148 recovered with tamper detection against 74 of 148 and 4 of 6 lost updates.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Lease TTL has a single workload-optimal value.
external_hypotheses.outcome: REJECTED with evidence — the argmin moves with cost weighting, so no single constant is retainable.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Producer self-certification is the dominant cause of false completion.
external_hypotheses.outcome: NOT_SUPPORTED on available evidence — discretionary persistence was the plurality category, 3 of 5 against 2 of 5.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Bounded hashed context capsules beat whole-tree admission at equal reasoning.
external_hypotheses.outcome: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — recall precondition holds; the live-model claim is NOT_YET, no model access in this runtime.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-family blind review catches a different defect class than same-family review.
external_hypotheses.outcome: SUPPORTED — two independently coded methodologies caught disjoint 4 of 8 sets pooling to 8 of 8.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Property and mutation testing find custody defects example tests miss.
external_hypotheses.outcome: SUPPORTED — two mutants survived the example suite and were caught by the harness.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: Structured hypothesis registration raises research-to-mechanism conversion.
external_hypotheses.outcome: SUPPORTED — 0.750 against 0.632, and correctness given a decisive verdict 0.981 against 0.483.

external_hypotheses.hypothesis: A single weighted headline score is a sound summary of generation quality.
external_hypotheses.outcome: REJECTED with executed evidence — on a real score pair it reports progress for a change that reintroduces a false completion.

reproductions.subject: twelve a5 reproductions, each with both arms actually executed
twelve a2 fault-class injections against the live control plane
eight a4 PO-01 pack qualifications re-executed from pinned immutable SHAs
a10 independent re-execution of every a4 and a9 claim, matching byte-for-byte
coordinator reproduction of DEF-01, DEF-13, DEF-17 and DEF-21 directly against live code
three generations scored on a frozen public suite and an evaluator-sourced holdout

live_mechanism_changes.change: Allowlist normalisation refuses absolute, empty and dot-segment paths instead of repairing them; ownership shares the normaliser.
Ingestion records what a subordinate actually achieved, so an honest failure is never promoted into a committed state.
The contract gate fires on the branches the work is actually done on.
The seeded validator enforces all twelve schema keywords and is self-contained, with a parity test preventing silent divergence.
Source capsules are pinned by (path, blob, commit) triples with versioned lineage and a three-state dispatch preflight.
Property and mutation harness plus a deterministic simulation scheduler adopted as standing test mechanisms.

independent_tests.test: a6 froze criteria and pushed them before the reviewed branches existed, then ran a mutation-based false-green detector.
a10 re-executed every a4 and a9 claim from pinned SHAs rather than reading and agreeing.
a1 drove all fifteen Obzio states by exhaustive search and confirmed no path reaches COMPLETED without coordinator ingestion.
Coordinator independently verified the validator imports and validates with only its own file present, and fails loudly on a bad document.
a8 scored G0, G1 and G2 on identical frozen inputs with recorded transcripts, reproducible via score_generations.py --check.
